title: Backpropagation through a two-layer MLP
summary: Forward pass with a cache and a backward pass that returns the gradient of every weight and bias of a two-layer sigmoid network.

mutants.divide_by_batch_only: Divides the loss gradient by N, not by N times n_out, so the gradient is too large when n_out is more than 1.
mutants.extra_activation_factor: Multiplies the gradient that flows back through W2 by a1 one extra time.
mutants.mean_bias_grad: Takes the mean of the hidden bias gradient over the batch, not the sum.
mutants.missing_factor_two: Drops the factor 2 from the derivative of the squared error.
mutants.no_hidden_sigmoid_grad: Forgets the sigmoid derivative of the hidden layer.
